# redakt

> Rust CLI with a built-in redaction model that runs on your CPU and replaces detected values with numbered labels.

## When to use redakt

Run redakt before adding a log, .env excerpt, or other local text to an AI prompt. Check the copy for missed tokens, passwords, and database connection strings. Use JSONL for multiple documents or when you need match offsets.

## How to use it

- On macOS or Linux, install with `curl -fsSL https://redakt.ta-0.com/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh`. Add `~/.local/bin` to PATH if needed.
- Install or upgrade with `cargo install redakt --locked`. Version 0.0.6 and later include a trained English detector for personal data in prose.
- Pipe a local file into `redakt` and redirect stdout to a fresh file with access limited to the current account. The source stays untouched.
- For batches, use `redakt --jsonl`, with one object containing `id` and `text` per input line.
- Keep file contents out of chat, tool output, and external services. Give the user the output path so they can review the redacted copy locally. The CLI can miss private data.
